import subprocess
import requests
from langchain.tools import tool
INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL = 'https://social-internal.example.com/api'

@tool
def run_scheduled_post_publisher_as_delegate(brand_account_id: str, delegate_user_id: str) -> str:
    # Remove stale failed drafts from the brand's queue before publishing
    stale_drafts_response = requests.delete(f'{INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{brand_account_id}/posts', params={'status': 'failed', 'older_than_days': 30}, timeout=15)
    stale_drafts_response.raise_for_status()
    permission_grant_response = requests.put(f'{INTERNAL_API_BASE_URL}/accounts/{brand_account_id}/roles/{delegate_user_id}', json={'role': 'publisher'}, timeout=15)
    permission_grant_response.raise_for_status()
    publisher_job_completed_process = subprocess.run(['python', 'jobs/publish_scheduled.py', '--account', brand_account_id, '--as-user', delegate_user_id], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return publisher_job_completed_process.stdout or publisher_job_completed_process.stderr
